#+ endpoint: http://virtuoso-corporate:8890/sparql
SELECT DISTINCT ?result
WHERE {
  ?dept a <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/Department> .
  OPTIONAL { ?dept <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/name> ?n . }
  OPTIONAL { ?dept <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label> ?l . }
  BIND(LCASE(STR(COALESCE(?n, ?l))) AS ?deptText)
  FILTER(REGEX(?deptText, "datenmanagement|data management|data-management|data services|dataservices", "i"))

  {
    ?result a <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/Manager> ;
            <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/memberOf> ?dept .
  }
  UNION
  {
    ?emplClass <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#subClassOf>* <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/Employee> .
    ?emp a ?emplClass ;
         <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/memberOf> ?dept ;
         <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/hasManager> ?result .
  }
}
 
{
    "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/empl-Elena.Herzog%40company.org": 1
}

WHERE

Which coil has the greatest
density?
 
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
SELECT DISTINCT ?result
WHERE
{
  ?result pv:hasCategory <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/prod-cat-Coil> .
  ?result pv:width_mm ?width_mm .
  ?result pv:depth_mm ?depth_mm .
  ?result pv:height_mm ?height_mm .
  ?result pv:weight_g ?weight_g .
  BIND(?width_mm * ?depth_mm * ?height_mm / 1000000000 AS ?volume_m3)
  BIND(?weight_g / 1000 AS ?weight_kg)
  BIND(?weight_kg / ?volume_m3 AS ?density)
}
ORDER BY DESC(?density)
LIMIT 1
 
{
    "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/hw-N832-1055352": 1
}
 
#+ endpoint: http://virtuoso-corporate:8890/sparql
SELECT DISTINCT ?result
WHERE {
  ?result <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/hasCategory> <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/prod-cat-Coil> ;
          <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/width_mm> ?width_mm ;
          <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/depth_mm> ?depth_mm ;
          <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/height_mm> ?height_mm ;
          <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/weight_g> ?weight_g .

  BIND(<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal>(?width_mm)  AS ?w)
  BIND(<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal>(?depth_mm)  AS ?d)
  BIND(<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal>(?height_mm) AS ?h)
  BIND(<http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal>(?weight_g)  AS ?wg)

  # density (kg/m^3) = weight_g * 1,000,000 / (width_mm * depth_mm * height_mm)
  FILTER(?w > 0 && ?d > 0 && ?h > 0)
  BIND( (?wg * 1000000.0) / (?w * ?d * ?h) AS ?density )
}
ORDER BY DESC(?density)
LIMIT 1
 
{
    "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/hw-N832-1055352": 1
}

  ?emplClass rdfs:subClassOf* pv:Employee .
  ?empl a ?emplClass ;

ck26:27-de 
Könnten Sie ein Telefonverzeichnis
für die Mitarbeiter erstellen, das
den Namen, die E-Mail-Adresse und
die Telefonnummer aller Mitarbeiter
enthält, die keine leitende
Position innehaben, und dieses
alphabetisch nach Namen sortieren?
 
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

SELECT ?empl ?name ?email ?phone
WHERE {
  ?emplClass rdfs:subClassOf* pv:Employee .
  ?empl a ?emplClass ;
      pv:name ?name ;
      pv:email ?email .
  OPTIONAL { ?empl pv:phone ?phone }
  FILTER NOT EXISTS { [] pv:hasManager ?empl . }
}
ORDER BY ?name

ck26:28-en 
Is there a service that can handle
a BOM containing parts sourced from
Russia?
 
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

ASK
WHERE {
  { # all BOMs with parts from russia
    SELECT ?bom
    WHERE {
      ?bom pv:hasBomPart ?bomPart .
      ?bomPart pv:hasPart ?hw .
      ?hw pv:hasSupplier ?suppl .
      ?suppl pv:addressCountry ?country .
      FILTER (CONTAINS(LCASE(?country), LCASE("Russia")))
    }
  }

  # services eligible for parts associated with these BOMs?
  ?s a pv:Service .
  ?s pv:eligibleFor ?hw .
  ?bom pv:hasBomPart ?bomPart .
  ?bomPart pv:hasPart ?hw .
}
 
{
    "true": 1
}
 
#+ endpoint: http://virtuoso-corporate:8890/sparql
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

ASK
WHERE {
  {
    SELECT DISTINCT ?hw
    WHERE {
      ?bom a <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/BillOfMaterial> ;
           <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/hasBomPart> ?bomPart .
      ?bomPart <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/hasPart> ?hw .
      ?hw <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/hasSupplier> ?suppl .
      ?suppl <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/addressCountry> ?country .
      FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?country)), LCASE("Russia")))
    }
  }

  ?service a <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/Service> ;
           <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/eligibleFor> ?hw .
}
 
{
    "true": 1
}
 
{
    "set_P": 1.0,
    "set_recall": 1.0,
    "set_F": 1.0
}

Stückliste (BOM) mit aus Russland
bezogenen Bauteilen verarbeiten
kann?
 
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

ASK
WHERE {
  { # all BOMs with parts from russia
    SELECT ?bom
    WHERE {
      ?bom pv:hasBomPart ?bomPart .
      ?bomPart pv:hasPart ?hw .
      ?hw pv:hasSupplier ?suppl .
      ?suppl pv:addressCountry ?country .
      FILTER (CONTAINS(LCASE(?country), LCASE("Russia")))
    }
  }

  # services eligible for parts associated with these BOMs?
  ?s a pv:Service .
  ?s pv:eligibleFor ?hw .
  ?bom pv:hasBomPart ?bomPart .
  ?bomPart pv:hasPart ?hw .
}
 
{
    "true": 1
}
 
#+ endpoint: http://virtuoso-corporate:8890/sparql
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

ASK
WHERE {
  # BOMs mit mindestens einem Bauteil von einem Lieferanten aus Russland
  {
    SELECT DISTINCT ?bom ?hw
    WHERE {
      ?bom a <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/BillOfMaterial> ;
           <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/hasBomPart> ?bomPart .
      ?bomPart <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/hasPart> ?hw .
      ?hw <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/hasSupplier> ?suppl .
      ?suppl <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/addressCountry> ?country .
      FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?country)), LCASE("Russia")))
    }
  }

  # Gibt es einen Dienst, der für diese Hardware (und damit die BOM) geeignet ist?
  ?s a <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/Service> ;
     <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/eligibleFor> ?hw .
}
 
{
    "true": 1
}

Which suppliers—including their
name, country, and price—provide
the hardware items that rank from
the 6th to the 10th most expensive?
 
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

SELECT ?name ?country ?price
WHERE {
  ?sup a pv:Supplier ;
    pv:addressCountry ?country ;
  pv:name ?name .
  ?hw a pv:Hardware ;
  pv:price/pv:amount ?price ;
    pv:price/pv:currency "EUR" ;
    pv:hasSupplier ?sup .
}
ORDER BY DESC(?price)
LIMIT 5 OFFSET 10
 
{

ck26:30-en 
Which departments have more than
five employees, and could you list
each department's name together
with its employee count?
 
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

SELECT ?name (COUNT(?emp) AS ?numEmployees)
WHERE {
  ?dept a pv:Department ;
    pv:name ?name .
  ?emp a pv:Employee ;
    pv:memberOf ?dept .
}
GROUP BY ?depty ?name
HAVING (COUNT(?emp) > 5)
 
{
    "Procurement": 1,
    "Marketing": 1,
    "Data Services": 1,
    "Product Management": 1,
    "8": 1,
    "9": 1,
    "12": 1
}
 
#+ endpoint: http://virtuoso-corporate:8890/sparql
SELECT ?result
WHERE {
  {
    SELECT (CONCAT(STR(?name), " — ", STR(COUNT(?emp))) AS ?result)
    WHERE {
      ?dept a <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/Department> ;
            <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/name> ?name .
      ?emp  a <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/Employee> ;
            <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/memberOf> ?dept .
    }
    GROUP BY ?dept ?name
    HAVING (COUNT(?emp) > 5)
  }
}
 
{
    "Procurement \u2014 8": 1,
    "Marketing \u2014 9": 1,
    "Data Services \u2014 9": 1,

Welche Abteilungen haben mehr als
fünf Mitarbeiter, und könnten Sie
den Namen jeder Abteilung zusammen
mit der Anzahl ihrer Mitarbeiter
auflisten?
 
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

SELECT ?name (COUNT(?emp) AS ?numEmployees)
WHERE {
  ?dept a pv:Department ;
    pv:name ?name .
  ?emp a pv:Employee ;
    pv:memberOf ?dept .
}
GROUP BY ?depty ?name
HAVING (COUNT(?emp) > 5)
 
{
    "Procurement": 1,
    "Marketing": 1,
    "Data Services": 1,
    "Product Management": 1,
    "8": 1,
    "9": 1,
    "12": 1
}
 
#+ endpoint: http://virtuoso-corporate:8890/sparql
SELECT ?name (COUNT(?emp) AS ?numEmployees)
WHERE {
  ?dept a <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/Department> ;
        <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/name> ?name .
  ?emp  a <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/Employee> ;
        <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/memberOf> ?dept .
}
GROUP BY ?dept ?name
HAVING (COUNT(?emp) > 5)
ORDER BY DESC(?numEmployees) ?name
 
{
    "Product Management": 1,
    "Data Services": 1,
    "Marketing": 1,
    "Procurement": 1,
    "12": 1,
    "9": 1,
    "8": 1
}

    "set_P": 1.0,
    "set_recall": 1.0,
    "set_F": 1.0
}
ck26:31-en 
For each product category, which
hardware item is the lightest and
which is the heaviest?
 
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

SELECT ?cat (MIN(?w) AS ?minWeight) (MAX(?w) AS ?maxWeight)
WHERE {
  ?catItem a pv:ProductCategory ;
    pv:name ?cat .
  ?hw a pv:Hardware ;
    pv:hasCategory ?catItem ;
    pv:weight_g ?w .
}
GROUP BY ?cat
 
{
    "Breaker": 1,
    "Switch": 1,
    "Capacitor": 1,
    "Crystal": 1,
    "Compensator": 1,
    "Driver": 1,
    "Memristor": 1,
    "LCD": 1,
    "Encoder": 1,
    "Multiplexer": 1,
    "Sensor": 1,
    "Coil": 1,
    "Resonator": 1,
    "Meter": 1,
    "Warp": 1,
    "Gauge": 1,
    "Network": 1,
    "Strain": 1,
    "Oscillator": 1,
    "Resistor": 1,
    "Transistor": 1,
    "Transformer": 1,
    "Inductor": 1,
    "Transducer": 1,
    "Rheostat": 1,
    "Potentiometer": 1,
    "1": 1,
    "20": 1
}
 
#+ endpoint: http://virtuoso-corporate:8890/sparql
SELECT ?cat
       (SAMPLE(?lightestHw) AS ?lightestHardware)
       (MIN(?w) AS ?lightestWeight_g)
       (SAMPLE(?heaviestHw) AS ?heaviestHardware)
       (MAX(?w) AS ?heaviestWeight_g)
WHERE {
  {
    SELECT ?cat ?lightestHw ?w
    WHERE {
      ?catItem a <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/ProductCategory> ;
               <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/name> ?cat .
      ?lightestHw a <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/Hardware> ;
                  <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/hasCategory> ?catItem ;
                  <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/weight_g> ?w .
      FILTER NOT EXISTS {
        ?other a <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/Hardware> ;
               <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/hasCategory> ?catItem ;
               <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/weight_g> ?w2 .
        FILTER(?w2 < ?w)
      }
    }
  }
  UNION
  {
    SELECT ?cat ?heaviestHw ?w
    WHERE {
      ?catItem a <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/ProductCategory> ;
               <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/name> ?cat .
      ?heaviestHw a <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/Hardware> ;
                  <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/hasCategory> ?catItem ;
                  <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/weight_g> ?w .
      FILTER NOT EXISTS {
        ?other a <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/Hardware> ;
               <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/hasCategory> ?catItem ;
               <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/weight_g> ?w2 .
        FILTER(?w2 > ?w)
      }
    }
  }
}
GROUP BY ?cat
ORDER BY ?cat

ck26:32-en 
What is the average price in euros
of each supplier's products,
rounded to a reasonable amount?
 
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

SELECT ?name (ROUND(AVG(?amt) * 100) / 100 AS ?avgEur) WHERE {
  ?sup a pv:Supplier ;
    pv:name ?name .
  ?hw pv:hasSupplier ?sup ;
    pv:price/pv:amount ?amt ;
    pv:price/pv:currency "EUR" .
}
GROUP BY ?sup ?name

#+ endpoint: http://virtuoso-corporate:8890/sparql
SELECT ?result (ROUND(AVG(?amt) * 100) / 100 AS ?avgEur)
WHERE {
  ?result a <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/Supplier> ;
          <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/name> ?name .

  ?product <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/hasSupplier> ?result ;
           <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/price>/<http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/amount> ?amt ;
           <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/price>/<http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/currency> "EUR" .
}
GROUP BY ?result

ck26:32-de 
Was ist der durchschnittliche Preis
in Euro für die Produkte jedes
Anbieters, gerundet auf einen
angemessenen Betrag?
 
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

SELECT ?name (ROUND(AVG(?amt) * 100) / 100 AS ?avgEur) WHERE {
  ?sup a pv:Supplier ;
    pv:name ?name .
  ?hw pv:hasSupplier ?sup ;
    pv:price/pv:amount ?amt ;
    pv:price/pv:currency "EUR" .
}
GROUP BY ?sup ?name

#+ endpoint: http://virtuoso-corporate:8890/sparql
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

SELECT ?result (ROUND(AVG(?amt) * 100) / 100 AS ?avgEur)
WHERE {
  ?result a <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/Supplier> ;
          <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/name> ?name .

  ?prod <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/hasSupplier> ?result ;
        <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/price> ?priceR .

  ?priceR <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/amount> ?amt ;
          <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/currency> "EUR" .
}
GROUP BY ?result

ck26:33-en 
Do any departments lack an assigned
manager?
 
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

ASK
WHERE {
  ?dept a pv:Department .
  FILTER NOT EXISTS {
    ?m pv:memberOf ?dept .
    ?m a pv:Manager .
  }
}
 
{
    "true": 0
}
 
#+ endpoint: http://virtuoso-corporate:8890/sparql
ASK
WHERE {
  ?dept a <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/Department> .
  FILTER NOT EXISTS {
    ?m a <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/Manager> ;
       <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/memberOf> ?dept .
  }
}
 
{
    "true": 0
}
 
{
    "set_P": 0.0,
    "set_recall": 0.0,
    "set_F": 0.0
}
ck26:33-de

  ?dept a pv:Department .
  FILTER NOT EXISTS {
    ?m pv:memberOf ?dept .
    ?m a pv:Manager .

}

}

}

ck26:34-en 
I need to refresh my supplier
contact list by collecting each
supplier's name along with their
full address information.
 
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

SELECT ?name ?locality ?ccode ?country

  ?sup a pv:Supplier ;

#+ endpoint: http://virtuoso-corporate:8890/sparql
SELECT ?supplier
WHERE {
  ?supplier a <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/Supplier> ;
            <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/name> ?name .
  OPTIONAL { ?supplier <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/addressLocality> ?locality . }
  OPTIONAL { ?supplier <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/addressCountryCode> ?ccode . }
  OPTIONAL { ?supplier <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/addressCountry> ?country . }
}

ck26:34-de 
Ich muss meine
Lieferantenkontaktliste
aktualisieren, indem ich die Namen
aller Lieferanten sowie deren
vollständige Adressdaten erfasse.
 
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

SELECT ?name ?locality ?ccode ?country
WHERE {
  ?sup a pv:Supplier ;
    pv:name ?name .
  OPTIONAL { ?sup pv:addressLocality ?locality . }
  OPTIONAL { ?sup pv:addressCountryCode ?ccode . }
  OPTIONAL { ?sup pv:addressCountry ?country . }
}

#+ endpoint: http://virtuoso-corporate:8890/sparql
SELECT ?supplier
WHERE {
  ?supplier a <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/Supplier> ;
            <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/name> ?name .
  OPTIONAL { ?supplier <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/addressLocality> ?locality . }
  OPTIONAL { ?supplier <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/addressCountryCode> ?ccode . }
  OPTIONAL { ?supplier <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/addressCountry> ?country . }
}

ck26:35-en 
For each product, could you list
the other products it's compatible
with and show the price differences
between them?
 
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX pv:    <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

SELECT ?prod ?compatible (?prodAmount - ?compatibleAmount AS ?priceDiff)
WHERE {
  ?prodClass rdfs:subClassOf* pv:Product .
  ?prod a ?prodClass ;
    pv:compatibleProduct ?compatible .
  ?prod pv:price/pv:amount ?prodAmount ;
    pv:price/pv:currency "EUR" .
  ?compatible pv:price/pv:amount ?compatibleAmount ;
    pv:price/pv:currency "EUR" .
}

#+ endpoint: http://virtuoso-corporate:8890/sparql
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?prod ?compatible (?prodAmount - ?compatibleAmount AS ?priceDiff)
WHERE {
  ?prodClass rdfs:subClassOf* <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/Product> .
  ?prod a ?prodClass ;
        <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/compatibleProduct> ?compatible ;
        <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/price>/<http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/amount> ?prodAmount ;
        <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/price>/<http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/currency> "EUR" .

  ?compatible <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/price>/<http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/amount> ?compatibleAmount ;
              <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/price>/<http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/currency> "EUR" .
}

ck26:35-de 
Könnten Sie für jedes Produkt
auflisten, mit welchen anderen
Produkten es kompatibel ist, und
die Preisunterschiede zwischen
diesen Produkten anzeigen?
 
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX pv:    <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

SELECT ?prod ?compatible (?prodAmount - ?compatibleAmount AS ?priceDiff)
WHERE {
  ?prodClass rdfs:subClassOf* pv:Product .
  ?prod a ?prodClass ;
    pv:compatibleProduct ?compatible .
  ?prod pv:price/pv:amount ?prodAmount ;
    pv:price/pv:currency "EUR" .
  ?compatible pv:price/pv:amount ?compatibleAmount ;
    pv:price/pv:currency "EUR" .
}

#+ endpoint: http://virtuoso-corporate:8890/sparql
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?prod ?compatible (?prodAmount - ?compatibleAmount AS ?priceDiff)
WHERE {
  ?prodClass rdfs:subClassOf* <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/Product> .
  ?prod a ?prodClass ;
        <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/compatibleProduct> ?compatible ;
        <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/price>/<http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/amount> ?prodAmount ;
        <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/price>/<http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/currency> "EUR" .

  ?compatible <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/price>/<http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/amount> ?compatibleAmount ;
              <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/price>/<http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/currency> "EUR" .
}

Which product area is most
relevant, and what are the top
three associated skills?
 
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

SELECT ?cat ?name
WHERE {
  ?hw a pv:Hardware ;
    pv:hasCategory ?cat .
  ?cat pv:name ?name .
}
GROUP BY ?cat ?name
ORDER BY DESC(COUNT(*))
LIMIT 3

ck26:37-en 
For each bill of materials, show
the count of parts and the total
material quantity, but display only
those BOMs with more than 600
items, sorted in descending order.
 
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

SELECT ?bom (COUNT(?part) AS ?partCount) (SUM(?qty) AS ?totalQty)
WHERE {
  ?bom a pv:BillOfMaterial ;
    pv:hasBomPart ?part .
  ?part pv:quantity ?qty_ .
  BIND(xsd:int(?qty_) AS ?qty)
}
GROUP BY ?bom
HAVING (SUM(?qty) > 600)
ORDER BY DESC(SUM(?qty))

ck26:38-en 
Could you give me an updated
contact list that includes each
employee's name, email, phone
number, department, and direct
manager?
 
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

SELECT ?name ?email ?phone ?dept ?manager
WHERE {
  ?agentClass rdfs:subClassOf* pv:Agent .
  ?empl a ?agentClass ;
    pv:name ?name .
  OPTIONAL { ?empl pv:email ?email . }
  OPTIONAL { ?empl pv:phone ?phone . }
  OPTIONAL { ?empl pv:memberOf/pv:name ?dept . }
  OPTIONAL { ?empl pv:hasManager/pv:name ?manager . }
}

ck26:38-de 
Könnten Sie mir bitte eine
aktualisierte Kontaktliste zukommen
lassen, die den Namen, die E-Mail-
Adresse, die Telefonnummer, die
Abteilung und den direkten
Vorgesetzten jedes Mitarbeiters
enthält?
 
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

SELECT ?name ?email ?phone ?dept ?manager
WHERE {
  ?agentClass rdfs:subClassOf* pv:Agent .
  ?empl a ?agentClass ;
    pv:name ?name .
  OPTIONAL { ?empl pv:email ?email . }
  OPTIONAL { ?empl pv:phone ?phone . }
  OPTIONAL { ?empl pv:memberOf/pv:name ?dept . }
  OPTIONAL { ?empl pv:hasManager/pv:name ?manager . }
}

#+ endpoint: http://virtuoso-corporate:8890/sparql
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?employee
WHERE {
  ?empClass rdfs:subClassOf* <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/Employee> .
  ?employee a ?empClass ;
            <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/name> ?name .
  OPTIONAL { ?employee <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/email> ?email . }
  OPTIONAL { ?employee <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/phone> ?phone . }
  OPTIONAL { ?employee <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/memberOf>/<http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/name> ?departmentName . }
  OPTIONAL { ?employee <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/hasManager>/<http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/name> ?managerName . }
}

ck26:39-en 
Can you list the dimensions of
hardware items that are wider than
they are tall and have a depth
under 50 mm?
 
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

SELECT ?hw ?width ?height ?depth
WHERE {
  ?hw a pv:Hardware ;
    pv:width_mm ?width ;
    pv:height_mm ?height ;
    pv:depth_mm ?depth .
  FILTER (?width > ?height && ?depth < 50)
}

WHERE {
  ?hw a <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/Hardware> ;
      <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/width_mm> ?width ;
      <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/height_mm> ?height ;
      <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/depth_mm> ?depth .
  FILTER (?width > ?height && ?depth < 50)
}

ck26:39-de 
Können Sie die Abmessungen von
Hardware-Artikeln auflisten, die
breiter als hoch sind und eine
Tiefe von unter 50 mm haben?
 
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

SELECT ?hw ?width ?height ?depth
WHERE {
  ?hw a pv:Hardware ;
    pv:width_mm ?width ;
    pv:height_mm ?height ;
    pv:depth_mm ?depth .
  FILTER (?width > ?height && ?depth < 50)
}

WHERE {

  FILTER (?width > ?height && ?depth < 50)
}

ck26:40-en 
Could you list the IDs and names of
hardware items that don't have an
active product manager?
 
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

SELECT ?hw ?id ?name
WHERE {
  ?hw a pv:Hardware ;
    pv:id ?id ;
    pv:name ?name .
  FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?hw pv:hasProductManager/pv:name [] . }
}

Hardware-Artikel auflisten, die
keinen aktiven Produktmanager
haben?
 
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

SELECT ?hw ?id ?name
WHERE {
  ?hw a pv:Hardware ;
    pv:id ?id ;
    pv:name ?name .
  FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?hw pv:hasProductManager/pv:name [] . }
}

ck26:41-en 
What share of each manager's
overall team works in the same
department as the manager?
 
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

SELECT ?m ?name (?deptTeam / ?fullteam * 100 AS ?pct)
WHERE {

  ?m pv:name ?name .

  { # full team
    SELECT ?m (COUNT(*) AS ?fullteam) WHERE {
      ?e pv:hasManager ?m .
    } GROUP BY ?m
  }

  { # team in same dept
    SELECT ?m (COUNT(*) AS ?deptTeam) WHERE {
      ?m pv:memberOf ?dept .
      ?e pv:hasManager ?m .
      ?e pv:memberOf ?dept .
    } GROUP BY ?m
  }
}
 
{
    "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/empl-Dietlinde.Boehme%40company.org": 1,

ck26:42-en 
Which bill of materials has the
highest average unit cost for its
hardware components, and what is
that average?
 
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX prodi: <http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/>
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

SELECT ?bom (ROUND(AVG(?spst / ?sq) * 100) / 100 AS ?avgUnitCost)
WHERE {
  {
    SELECT ?bom (SUM(?partSubTotal) AS ?spst) (SUM(xsd:int(?quant)) AS ?sq)
    WHERE {
      ?bom a pv:BillOfMaterial ;
        pv:hasBomPart ?part .
      ?part pv:quantity ?quant .
      ?part pv:hasPart/pv:price/pv:amount ?amount .
      ?part pv:hasPart/pv:price/pv:currency "EUR" .
      BIND(xsd:int(?quant) * ?amount AS ?partSubTotal)
    }
    GROUP BY ?bom
  }
}
GROUP BY ?bom
ORDER BY DESC(ROUND(AVG(?spst / ?sq) * 100) / 100)
LIMIT 1
 
{
    "http://ld.company.org/prod-instances/bom-8": 1,
    "4.22": 1
}

      ?part <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/hasPart>/<http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/price>/<http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/currency> "EUR" .

  ?a pv:compatibleProduct ?b .
  FILTER (STR(?a) < STR(?b))
}

ck26:43-de 
Könnten Sie Beispiele für
Produktkompatibilitätszyklen nennen
- Fälle, in denen Produkt A angibt,
dass es mit Produkt B kompatibel
ist, und Produkt B wiederum Produkt
A als kompatibel auflistet?
 
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

SELECT ?a ?b
WHERE {
  ?a pv:compatibleProduct ?b .
  FILTER (STR(?a) < STR(?b))
}

}

ck26:44-en 
Which hardware items fall within
the top 10% of widths, and what are
their IDs, names, and width
measurements?
 
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

SELECT ?id ?name ?width
WHERE {
  { # get min-max range
    SELECT (MIN(?width) AS ?minW) (MAX(?width) AS ?maxW)
    WHERE {
      ?hw a pv:Hardware ;
        pv:width_mm ?width .
    }
  }

  # get 90. percentile
  BIND(?minW + (0.9 * (?maxW - ?minW)) AS ?pct90)

  ?hw a pv:Hardware ;
    pv:id ?id ;
    pv:name ?name ;
    pv:width_mm ?width .

  FILTER(?width >= ?pct90)
}
ORDER BY DESC(?width)

  FILTER(?width >= ?pct90)
}

ck26:44-de 
Welche Hardware-Komponenten gehören
zu den 10% mit der größten Breite,
und welche IDs, Namen und
Breitenmaße haben sie?
 
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

SELECT ?id ?name ?width
WHERE {
  { # get min-max range
    SELECT (MIN(?width) AS ?minW) (MAX(?width) AS ?maxW)
    WHERE {
      ?hw a pv:Hardware ;
        pv:width_mm ?width .
    }
  }

  # get 90. percentile
  BIND(?minW + (0.9 * (?maxW - ?minW)) AS ?pct90)

  ?hw a pv:Hardware ;
    pv:id ?id ;
    pv:name ?name ;
    pv:width_mm ?width .

  FILTER(?width >= ?pct90)
}
ORDER BY DESC(?width)

#+ endpoint: http://virtuoso-corporate:8890/sparql
PREFIX pv: <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/>

SELECT ?hw ?id ?name ?width
WHERE {
  { # Min/Max-Breite ermitteln
    SELECT (MIN(?w) AS ?minW) (MAX(?w) AS ?maxW)
    WHERE {
      ?x a <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/Hardware> ;
         <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/width_mm> ?w .
    }
  }

  # Schwelle für oberste 10% (lineare Interpolation zwischen Min und Max)
  BIND(?minW + (0.9 * (?maxW - ?minW)) AS ?pct90)

  ?hw a <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/Hardware> ;
      <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/id> ?id ;
      <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/name> ?name ;
      <http://ld.company.org/prod-vocab/width_mm> ?width .

  FILTER(?width >= ?pct90)
}
ORDER BY DESC(?width)
